title: Check out my podcast: The Sunset Project. #sunsetboulevard #bettybuck...
transcript: And that this iconic piece of musical theater has lived over these decades to the point where someone who was born in the same year that it was on Broadway got to director production of it. And the show was my entry point to discovering some of the most amazing musical theater actresses of our time. Betty Buckley, Patti Lapone, Elaine Paige, Karen Mason. The list goes on and on. 30 years. My goodness, how frightening.
